mapper.select: SELECT rob.* FROM b_xiecheng_colliding_data_rob rob JOIN b_xiecheng_colliding_data_package pkg ON rob.package_id = pkg.id WHERE pkg.is_delete = 0 and pkg.retry_count = 0 and pkg.colliding_time <= now() and DATE_FORMAT(rob.push_time, '%Y-%m-%d') != curdate() ORDER BY pkg.priority limit ${limit}
